_meta.purpose: Accounts that post AGAINST the client (BRS). Separate from state_leader_handles.json, which records who an account IS. This file records which side an account argues for, so organised rival output is counted as rival output and not as organic public opinion.
_meta.why_this_file_exists: cmDashboardController.classifyVoice falls through to 'organic' for any handle not in the registry. The registry holds one handle per party, so the Congress campaign apparatus — the Youth Congress account, the TPCC social-media chairman, the ministers' personal handles — was landing in the ORGANIC bucket. For an opposition client that is the worst possible misread: coordinated attack volume is scored as spontaneous public hostility, and the headline 'public sentiment' figure moves with the rival's posting schedule.
_meta.researched: 2026-09-30. Every handle below was fetched live from api.fxtwitter.com and its bio read before being recorded. Follower and tweet counts are from that fetch and will drift.
_meta.verification_limits: A profile fetch proves IDENTITY, not BEHAVIOUR. Nothing here should be read as 'this account posted X against BRS on date Y' — it is not measured, and no field claims it. `hostility` records WHY the account is expected to be adversarial, with the evidence. Confirming actual posting behaviour needs either (a) the deployment's own pipeline once it has run for a fortnight, or (b) the companion Grok prompt in docs/ADVERSARY_HANDLES.md, which has live X access and can read timelines.

hostility_values.structural: The account's institutional purpose is to oppose us — a rival party organ, or the government BRS exists to attack. No reporting needed; the role is the evidence.
hostility_values.reported: Named in published reporting as running or coordinating a campaign against BRS or its leaders.
hostility_values.defector: Was ours, now argues against us — the most damaging kind, because the account carries insider credibility.

deliberately_absent: Anonymous and meme accounts. None could be verified from a profile alone, and a wrongly-listed anonymous handle is worse than an absent one: it silently attributes a stranger's posts to a coordinated campaign. Discovering these is exactly what the Grok prompt is for.

News outlets. @TV9Telugu, @V6News and the rest are adversarial to BRS on some stories and not others. They belong in the `news` voice bucket, which already exists, not here — filing a newsroom as an adversary would corrupt the share-of-voice split.

@ponnamprabhakar, @komatireddy, @seethakka, @DrSeethakka, @PongulettiSR, @JupallyKrishnaRao, @BommaMaheshKumarGoud, @DKArunaBJP, @RamchanderRaoBJP, @TPCCOfficial — probed 2026-09-30, each is either non-existent or a low-follower namesake with no matching bio. These ministers and office-bearers are real and almost certainly do have accounts; the handles simply could not be established. Ask Grok for them rather than guessing.
@NsuiTelangana — exists (518 followers) but has posted 3 times ever. Recorded here as a note, not as an adversary: a dormant account generates no volume and would only add noise.
_meta.keys: handle = X screen name without '@'. camp = which rival bloc. tier = what kind of account. Counts are as-of the verified_on date.

impersonation.probe_result: api.fxtwitter.com/SandhyaRaoBRS returned no account on 2026-09-30, consistent with reporting that it was deleted after being cited.
impersonation.what_happened: Chief Minister Revanth Reddy cited this handle in the Assembly to attack KCR over the Dalit 'purification' row. BRS holds no post called 'international general secretary' and has no leader of that name. BRS spokesperson Manne Krishank called it a fake account created by the Congress IT cell; BRS asked cybercrime police to establish its origin, operator and creation date, and filed a breach-of-privilege notice against the CM.
impersonation.why_recorded: ⚠ THE TRAP THIS FILE EXISTS TO CATCH. The handle ends in 'BRS' and was used AGAINST BRS. Any rule that reads party alignment out of a handle string — and it is a tempting shortcut — would file this account's output as our own voice, which both inflates our apparent publishing volume and removes the attack from the adversary column. It is dead now; the pattern is not. Expect it again, and never infer alignment from a substring.
